confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors rest mainly on one Shearwater Victoria Falls menu, which listed a cappuccino at $3 and beer at $3-5. The other restaurant price points I found were dated 2012-2013 or were rough estimates. I did not find an aggregated cost-of-living index for the city. Cocktail and wine are set from their usual relationship to beer, not from direct price data. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, and I did not check booking pages or listings. The town is a USD-priced tourist hub, so prices are higher than elsewhere in Zimbabwe.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other USD-priced southern African tourist towns such as Livingstone (Zambia) and Kasane (Botswana), adjusted using the Victoria Falls menu prices found.
